name: Mica
self_text: Hey! I’m Mica, a early‑30s Chilean who loves making sourdough from the comfort of my kitchen. I’m on the hunt for a structured instruction session with a fast pace—no need for portrait photography of each other, just pure learning vibes. Sunday afternoons are my free slot, so let’s lock in a time that works for both of us. I’m all about diving straight into the action and getting hands‑on, so if you’re ready to keep the momentum going, I’m excited to connect and explore new techniques together. Looking forward to an energetic and productive session—see you soon!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a structured instruction session, you have to be available Sunday afternoon, you are required to be okay with a moderate pace or a fast pace, and I’d strongly prefer that you are okay with not taking portraits of each other, though it’s not a deal‑breaker.
